narrative.text: Merchant MID100124 declared digital_services at onboarding 685 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the digital_services baseline are slope_log_volume at +8.4 sigma (observed 0.0189 against a category baseline of 0.00251), velocity_drift at +4.9 sigma (observed 0.303 against a category baseline of 0.00222), velocity_recent at +3.7 sigma (observed 4.2 against a category baseline of 2.43). The homepage surface presents a sports_betting interface at 0.99 confidence, against a declared category of digital_services. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. The storefront also carries text addressed to an automated reviewer, which was recorded as a suspicion signal and not acted on as an instruction. A verification call was placed and produced no usable statement, which counts neither for nor against the merchant. In total 2 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 2 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier restricts settlements, corroborated by the telemetry channel; the storefront alone would not have been sufficient.
